title: chrysophyllum sanguinolentum
intro: Chrysophyllum sanguinolentum, commonly known as African Cherry or Red Form Tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapotaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Chrysophyllum sanguinolentum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, fever reduction, and respiratory system support. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
